title: REQ · Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Radix, Motion and Lucide are configured in game/frontend
summary: UI dependencies and Tailwind/shadcn configuration exist and the stylesheet loads Tailwind
description: Context: package.json has only react, react-dom and yaml. Desired behavior: add tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, zustand, motion, lucide-react, @radix-ui/react-dialog, class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, with tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js, components.json, a cn helper and Tailwind directives in styles.css. Result: any component can use Tailwind utilities and the cn helper. Why: design-system base.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, when read, then each listed dependency is declared
Given tailwind.config.ts, when loaded, then content includes ./index.html and ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
Given cn('a', false, 'b'), when called, then it returns 'a b' and merges conflicting Tailwind classes
Given styles.css, when read, then it contains the @tailwind base, components and utilities directives

in_scope: package.json, tailwind/postcss/shadcn config, cn helper, styles.css directives

definition_of_done: Dependencies and configs committed; app still builds
